sn7.17:1.2: Navakammika, “builder”. The causative form is used, kārāpeti. He was not a manual laborer, but someone who supervised others to get the work done.
sn7.17:3.2: Accept the reading visukkha, which is supported by SA2 96, 一切盡枯.
sn7.17:3.3: This verse plays on vana (“jungle”) and vanatha, explained by the commentary as “undergrowth”, and applied in the sense of the tangles and “snarls” of craving.
